user.title: Smart ECOcontrol
user.description: IP address of the Smart ECOcontrol box on the network Home Assistant is connected to (the box must be reachable from Home Assistant).

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the box at this address.
error.invalid_response: This address answers, but it is not a recognised Smart ECOcontrol box.

data.derogation_hours: Default override duration (hours, at most until midnight)

setpoint_not_settable.message: Cannot change the setpoint: the room must be in Auto mode on the Comfort level (Smart button on the device) and not use a pilot wire.

room_selection_lost.message: Command cancelled for safety: the box no longer targets this room (a web interface page open elsewhere changes the selected room). Close the box's web pages and try again.

setpoint_out_of_range.message: Setpoint {requested} °C refused: the box only accepts {minimum} to {maximum} °C around the preferred temperature.

derogation_unavailable.message: Override "{kind}" is not possible in the room's current mode (mode {mode}). Outside Auto mode the box only allows frost protection, and nothing in Off or Frost mode.

hvac_mode_physical.message: The mode cannot be changed remotely: use the Smart button on the device. Remotely, only the setpoint, overrides and schedule can be changed.

vacation_date_invalid.message: Invalid resume date ({date}): it must be after today (box time) and within the next 12 months.

config_entry_missing.message: No Smart ECOcontrol box is loaded.

config_entry_ambiguous.message: Several Smart ECOcontrol boxes: choose one with config_entry_id.

time_invalid.message: Invalid time: {value} (HH:MM format, in 15-minute steps, from 00:00 to 24:00).

planning_no_schedule.message: “Sans planning” has no ranges: a room using it follows no schedule.

planning_selection_lost.message: Write cancelled for safety: the box no longer describes this schedule (a web interface page opened elsewhere changes the displayed schedule). Close the box pages and try again.

schedule_too_many_ranges.message: At most {maximum} comfort ranges per day.

schedule_range_invalid.message: Invalid comfort range ({range}): the end must follow the start, between 00:00 and 24:00.

schedule_range_too_short.message: Comfort range too short ({range}): 1 hour minimum.

schedule_ranges_too_close.message: Comfort ranges too close ({range}): at least 1 hour between two ranges, no overlap.

schedule_not_applied.message: The box did not apply the change (day {day}: requested {expected}, read back {found}). Try again and check the schedule on the box.

planning_name_invalid.message: Invalid schedule name: letters, digits and spaces only, {maximum} characters at most.

planning_limit.message: The box only handles {maximum} schedules (including “Sans planning”).

planning_not_applied.message: The box did not take the schedule change into account. Try again or check on the box.

planning_protected.message: “Sans planning” is the default schedule: it cannot be renamed or deleted.

planning_in_use.message: Schedule “{planning}” is still used by: {rooms}. Give those rooms another schedule first.

set_derogation.name: Force a mode (override)
set_derogation.description: Temporarily forces a room's mode, at most until midnight.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Duration in hours. Default: the duration set in the integration options.

cancel_derogation.name: Cancel override
cancel_derogation.description: Removes the current override and goes back to the schedule.

set_vacation.name: Schedule vacation
set_vacation.description: Puts every radiator in frost protection until the chosen date, then resumes heating.

until.name: Heating resumes
until.description: Date heating resumes (tomorrow at the earliest, within 12 months).

get_planning.name: Read a schedule
get_planning.description: Returns the list of schedules and, if one is given, its comfort ranges (read back from the box).

planning.name: Schedule
planning.description: Schedule name or number. Empty: only the list of schedules.

config_entry_id.name: Box
config_entry_id.description: Only if several boxes are configured.

set_planning_day.name: Set the ranges of a day
set_planning_day.description: Replaces the comfort ranges of one or more days of a schedule; the rest of the day is Eco. Box rules: at most 5 ranges, 1 hour minimum each, 1 hour minimum between two ranges.

ranges.name: Comfort ranges
ranges.description: List of {start, end} ranges in HH:MM, 15-minute steps. Empty list: whole day in Eco.

config_entry_id.name: Box
config_entry_id.description: Only if several boxes are configured.

copy_planning_day.name: Copy a day
copy_planning_day.description: Copies the comfort ranges of one day to other days of the same schedule.

config_entry_id.name: Box
config_entry_id.description: Only if several boxes are configured.

create_planning.name: Create a schedule
create_planning.description: Creates an empty schedule (all Eco). Name: letters, digits and spaces, 25 characters at most.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name of the new schedule (upper-cased, accents removed).

config_entry_id.name: Box
config_entry_id.description: Only if several boxes are configured.

rename_planning.name: Rename a schedule
rename_planning.description: Changes the name of a schedule.

name.name: New name
name.description: Letters, digits and spaces, 25 characters at most.

config_entry_id.name: Box
config_entry_id.description: Only if several boxes are configured.

delete_planning.name: Delete a schedule
delete_planning.description: Deletes a schedule that no room uses.

config_entry_id.name: Box
config_entry_id.description: Only if several boxes are configured.
